subject: Computação
description_pt: Organizar objetos físicos ou digitais considerando diferentes características para esta organização, explicitando semelhanças (padrões) e diferenças.

components.description_pt: Classificar objetos físicos em grupos baseados em características compartilhadas
components.description_en: Sort physical objects into groups based on shared characteristics
components.cc_component_description: Classify materials into groups based on shared observable properties such as color, texture, hardness, or flexibility

components.description_pt: Identificar explicitamente similaridades que definem um padrão entre objetos agrupados
components.description_en: Explicitly identify similarities that define a pattern among grouped objects
components.cc_component_description: Identify similarities and differences in patterns to sort and classify natural phenomena

components.description_pt: Identificar diferenças que distinguem objetos pertencentes a grupos separados
components.description_en: Identify differences that distinguish objects belonging to separate groups
components.cc_component_description: Identify observable properties that distinguish one kind of material from another

cc_matches.description: Plan and conduct an investigation to describe and classify different kinds of materials by their observable properties.
Similarities and differences in patterns can be used to sort, classify, communicate and analyze simple rates of change for natural phenomena and designed products.
